title: upgrade: attention kernels -> FlashAttention variants, fused ops, and rotary/rope optimizations
author: Ava Chen
description: Motivation: Reduce token-level latency and GPU compute for common transformer workloads by upgrading attention kernels and fusing hot-path ops. This PR introduces a set of FlashAttention variants tuned for our runtime, a fused QKV+attn softmax path for FP16/AMP, and optimized rotary/rope application that avoids redundant kernel launches. It also includes scheduler hints to improve continuous-batching packing and KV-cache touch patterns to reduce memory traffic. High-level changes: - Add flash_attn_v1/v2 wrappers and selection heuristic (kernel selector chooses best variant based on seq_len, batch_size, head_dim, and hardware) - Implement fused qkv_linear+reshape+transposes -> single kernel for common BxSxH shapes - Inline rotary/rope into attention kernel for 2x speedup on rotary-heavy models - Scheduler: add attention-priority packing hint to continuous-batching to favor short-latency requests and reduce tail latency - KV-cache: prefetch hint and compacted layout for faster lookup when sequence growth is dominated by appends - Fallbacks: CPU/legacy path preserved; degraded kernels used when shapes don't match constraints Backwards compatibility: no API changes; model weights unchanged. Rollout plan: staged rollout via canary on Dedicated pools, A/B test on ~5% of hosted traffic, metric gating on p50/p95 latency, GPU utilization and puzz element cost per token. Performance results (internal bench, nv4/v100-like): - GPT-like model, seq=512, batch=8: per-token latency reduced ~28% end-to-end - Transformer-xl style with rope: token throughput +35% due to fused rotary - KV-cache heavy workload: p95 generation latency reduced ~18% and memory bandwidth pressure down ~22% Known limitations: flash_attn_v2 currently requires cuBLAS/cuDNN>=... (environment note shown in docs), some long-sequence shapes fall back to non-fused path. Checklist: [x] Benchmarks added and reproducible [x] Unit tests for kernel selector and fallback [x] Integration tests for streaming and kv-cache [x] Added rollout plan and feature flagging [x] Docs note for private deployments on dependency requirements Related: Linear ENG-3221 (attention perf), ENG-3304 (rotary optimization), incident INT-1292 referenced for earlier regression. See commits summary and changed_files for details.
